title: Regular affine truncated alteration hypercovers adapted to a dense open
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced quasi-excellent Noetherian scheme, let $U\subseteq Y$ be a dense open, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible on $Y$, and let $L\geq0$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-open-immersion]. There is an augmented simplicial diagram $P_\bullet\to Y$ through degree $L$, all of whose levels are affine regular Noetherian schemes of finite type over $Y$, such that its matching maps are covers for the topology of $\ell'$-alterations [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-per-prime-to-ell-alteration-topology]. Matching objects are finite limits in $\operatorname{alt}/Y$; their fibre products are the reduced unions of components of ordinary fibre products dominating a component of the base. For every $0\leq i\leq L$, the reduced complement of $U\times_Y P_i$ is a strict normal crossings divisor in $P_i$ [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Empty complements and disconnected levels are allowed.

source.place: IX Theorem 1.1, printed p.131, combined with the matching-object construction of XIII Theorem 2.2.2, printed pp.196–197, and XV 3.1.2, printed p.222. Use IX rather than the weaker VII theorem for the prime-to-ell version.
